correctness.rationale: On each arc, every configuration has a positive-rate path into a unique closed irreducible single-interface birth-death class. From detailed balance, Pr(I=i)=r^i/Z_a(r) and Pr(J=j)=r^j/Z_b(r), independently; X=1+I+J and PGF t Z_a(rt) Z_b(rt)/(Z_a(r)Z_b(r)). At r>1, the real extension f_x=x/(1-exp(-x log r))-r/(r-1) has f_x''>0 via h(z)=(z-2)+(z+2)e^-z, h(0)=0 and h'>0; hence balancing strictly decreases mean. At r<1, f_m(r)=m-1-f_m(1/r) reverses curvature; r=1 mean n/2. For b>=a+2, balancing changes the normalizer by (r^(b-1)-r^a)/(r-1)>0, with positive r=1 limit, so both endpoint masses fall. Length-one arcs and nearly balanced arcs are explicitly included. These computations establish the all-n result, not the finite verifier alone. As an additional independent check, a newly implemented 132-case exact finite-state continuous-time generator calculation (n=4..9, every placement, four rational rate pairs) verified zero global stationary flux and the full convolution probabilities over 7,152 transient-and-recurrent configurations.
